_conventions: who_can_write: list of actors or role-relative names (from_role, to_role, owner, holder, session_end_hook, reclaim); gyb is exempt from this column (header rule 1). preconditions: {id, text, source}; the id names the check rl_lib implements. to == from means a content-only append (04 L80).

header_rules.text: gyb is exempt from the who_can_write column.

The preconditions column is integrity validation and applies to gyb; gyb bypasses it with --force --reason, which is recorded; --force cannot bypass a transition that is not in the table (exit 2 even for gyb; to force a status change use withdraw then reopen).

holder is non-empty if and only if status is in_progress: entering in_progress writes holder; every exit from in_progress clears holder and copies it into last_holder; start requires an empty holder; session end only checks in_progress orders.
stuck orders are not touched by session end or reclaim (holder already empty); only resume after the issue is answered brings them back to todo.
owner is from_role and is a role, not a session; quick-lane supplements and gyb-opened orders record owner gyb; the quick-lane supplement is opened by deploy with owner recorded as gyb.

preconditions.text: work_order has decision_refs (at least one) and explanation
work_order has track (direction name filled by idea at open)
preconditions.source: sync-inbox Q45(a)(f) L329-330; proxy decision D-10 (04 L43 and 11 L76: a launch order copies track from its parent, so the work order must carry it)

preconditions.text: launch_order has parent_id and a first attempt with command, workdir, track, config; run_id is assigned by rl as <ho-id>-a<attempt>; decision_refs, batch and track are copied from the parent
analysis_order has evaluation_refs (each may still be proposed)

rows.then_who_pulls: dispatch=auto: the owner starts a background subagent; manual: waits for gyb; none: nothing

side_effects.text: withdrawing from in_progress opens a withdrawn notification to the holder's role and to the owner; other statuses do not notify
--cascade also withdraws, on the owner's behalf, the orders whose parent_id points at this one; the downstream rows record the initiator as actor
the holder reports the code location and the half-finished artifact directory into that withdrawn issue; nothing is moved, gyb decides
